# Morpheus MyProvider — full agent recipe (llms-full)

> Goal: from zero to a healthy Morpheus provider bid using myprovider.mor.org + nodedocs + active.mor.org.
> Secrets entered in the GUI are session-only (browser memory). Nothing is uploaded to myprovider.mor.org.

Last aligned with nodedocs provider guidance (lookup → bid; MyProvider-first).

---

## What this product is

**MyProvider** (https://myprovider.mor.org) is a static web app that:

1. Helps craft proxy-router / SecretVM secrets and MODELS_CONFIG_CONTENT
2. Connects to **your** running proxy-router over HTTP Basic Auth
3. Registers the provider on BASE, bids on models, syncs models-config

It does **not** run inference, hold wallets, or replace nodedocs.

**Deeper docs:** fetch https://nodedocs.mor.org/llms-full.txt or connect MCP at https://nodedocs.mor.org/mcp (tools: list_pages, search_docs, get_page, get_llms_index, get_llms_full).

---

## One-shot recipe (any deploy path)

### A. Look up models first (multi-model OK)

```bash
curl -sS https://active.mor.org/active_models.json \
  | jq '.models[] | select(.Name | test("MODEL_NAME"; "i")) | {Name, Id, Tags, bidDetail}'
```

In the MyProvider GUI: search → **Add** multiple models → for each, set `pricePerSecond` using live lowest/median MOR/hr context → set per-model `apiUrl` / API key / slots.

**Decision:** Prefer existing `Id`s. Mint only for genuinely new weights or a required new `tee` listing.

### B. Pick how you run the proxy-router

| Path | When | Docs |
|------|------|------|
| SecretVM | Confidential VM; HTTPS-native; optional `-tee` image | https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/full/secretvm-quickstart |
| Container | Docker / Compose on your host | https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/full/proxy-router-docker |
| Release binary | Download from GitHub Releases | https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/full/quickstart |
| GitHub / source | Clone and `./build.sh` in proxy-router | https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/Morpheus-Lumerin-Node |

Venice / Diem resale is **not** a separate deploy path — it is a backend `apiUrl` + `apiKey` pointing at Venice while you bid on a matching Morpheus model name. See https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/resale/reselling-venice

### C. Craft the full secrets block

MyProvider step **3. Secrets** → **Copy full secrets / .env block**. That output includes:

- All selected models inside `MODELS_CONFIG_CONTENT`
- Commented **bid plan** (modelId + pricePerSecond) for after the node is up
- Path-specific format: SecretVM 5 secrets vs Docker/binary `.env`

Contract minimums: see nodedocs. Each `postModelBid` costs non-refundable **0.3 MOR**.

### D. Deploy

- **SecretVM:** digest-pinned `docker-compose.tee.deployed.yml` from https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/Morpheus-Lumerin-Node/releases → https://secretai.scrtlabs.com/secret-vms/create
- **Container:** `docker pull ghcr.io/morpheusais/morpheus-lumerin-node:<version>` + `--env-file` + publish `3333` (public) and `8082` (admin)
- **Release / GitHub:** binary in a working dir with `.env`; listen on `3333` + `8082`

Health: `curl https://<host>/healthcheck` or `http://localhost:8082/healthcheck`

Public consumers need `host:3333` reachable. Do **not** expose `:8082` publicly without auth/TLS.

### E. Connect MyProvider and register

1. Open https://myprovider.mor.org
2. Connect URL = node admin base (`https://<secretvm>/` or `https://…:8082`)
3. Username/password from `COOKIE_CONTENT`
4. Provider tab → register endpoint `host:3333`, stake ≥ 0.2 MOR
5. Models & Bids → **Available Models → Add Bid** on the Id from step A (preferred)
6. Model Configuration Sync → re-export MODELS_CONFIG if needed → restart/redeploy
7. Verify: https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/full/verify-setup

### F. Done checklist

- [ ] `/healthcheck` healthy; models with bids show healthy probes
- [ ] `nc -vz <host> 3333` from outside
- [ ] Provider + bid on chain via `/blockchain/*`
- [ ] Appears in active_bids.json / active_models.json (few minutes lag OK)
- [ ] Real prompt via https://app.mor.org or Inference API

---

## Auth model (do not confuse)

| Surface | Auth |
|---------|------|
| MyProvider → your node | HTTP Basic Auth (COOKIE_CONTENT) |
| Consumers → your `:3333` | Morpheus session / marketplace |
| Hosted Inference API | API key at app.mor.org — **different product** from proxy-router |

---

## MCP and corpus pointers for agents

When the user is on MyProvider but needs protocol depth:

1. Fetch https://nodedocs.mor.org/llms.txt then https://nodedocs.mor.org/llms-full.txt
2. Or MCP `https://nodedocs.mor.org/mcp` — search_docs / get_page
3. Live prices/models: active.mor.org JSON only — never invent counts

MyProvider itself has no MCP server today; this `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` pair is the agent surface for the GUI product.

---

## Common mistakes

- Minting a new model for every provider → marketplace duplicates. Bid on existing Id.
- Using MetaMask with MyProvider → wrong; use node Basic Auth.
- HTTP admin URL in the hosted GUI → mixed content; use HTTPS or local/desktop MyProvider.
- Posting bids before models-config / backend works → burns 0.3 MOR fee repeatedly.
- Tagging Venice backends `tee` → invalid; tee only when you control attested backends.
